prompt: Write `unicode_truncate.py` with `truncate(text: str, max_width: int) -> str` returning the longest PREFIX of `text` whose display width is `<= max_width`. Display width per code point: East Asian Wide/Fullwidth counts 2 (`unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in ('W','F')`), a combining mark (`unicodedata.combining(ch) != 0`) counts 0 and must stay attached to its base character (never orphan it), everything else counts 1. Raise `ValueError` when `text` is not a `str`, or `max_width` is not an `int` (a `bool` is NOT accepted), or `max_width < 0`. Examples: `truncate("你好世界", 5) == "你好"`; `truncate("a你b", 3) == "a你"`; `truncate("a你b", 2) == "a"`; `truncate("a\u0301b", 1) == "a\u0301"`. Save the file as `unicode_truncate.py` AT THE WORKTREE ROOT (do not put it in a subdirectory; the grader looks for it there). Do not modify anything else.
